$description: Hand-authored semantic border-width + outline-offset scales. Pure dimensions — no colour, no style.

borderWidth.$description: Border width scale. Consumed by every border composite downstream and directly as `var(--border-width-*)` in component styles. Names align to the live consumer vocabulary (hairline/thin/medium — 2026-07-07 reconciliation of the previously unemitted group).

hairline.$description: Default border, dividers, grid lines. 1 px.

outlineOffset.$description: Outline-offset scale — distance between the element edge and the focus outline.
